title: The Scene Every Salesman Needs to See
description:

🔑 Stop Chasing Customers. Create Them.

What if you never had to chase another client again?

Learn how to create demand by repositioning your offer - just like Saul Goodman did.

In this breakdown, Chris Do dissects a masterclass in positioning, marketing, and sales hidden inside an unlikely place: Better Call Saul. 

You’ll learn how Saul turned a dead-end cell phone gig into a thriving business by reframing the product and creating a new type of customer. 

If your business is stuck in the noise, this is how you break free.

This video is for you if...
🎯 You feel like you're constantly chasing leads that never convert
🧲 You’re not standing out in a saturated market
😫 You're tired of “selling” and want demand to come to you
🛠️ You're stuck describing your offer in terms of features, not value
🧠 You want to understand real positioning—not just buzzwords
🌊 You’re ready to shift from red ocean to blue ocean strategy

In this episode:
